lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows, forming a regular grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Narrow vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that cross the horizontal rows of blobs, creating high-contrast nodal points where the vertical and horizontal light patterns overlap.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running parallel along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light upper margins to shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora silhouette attached to the ventral-lateral region just posterior to the pectoral fin's trailing edge.
